description:
ArgonBuyAndTransfer.buyAndTransfer(ArgonBuyAndTransfer.Request,PoolKey,bytes) (contracts/ArgonBuyAndTransfer.sol#66-116) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- burnAmount = purchase.argonBought / _SCALE * _SCALE (contracts/ArgonBuyAndTransfer.sol#110)
reason: buyAndTransfer rounds to the same 1e12 scale as the gateway and returns the remainder to the buyer.
assumptions: Runtime units remain 6 decimals, token units 18 decimals, and the sub-microgon remainder is returned to the buyer.

description:
StabilizationPoolHook._writeObservation() (contracts/StabilizationPoolHook.sol#139-147) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- observationCardinality == 0 (contracts/StabilizationPoolHook.sol#140)
reason: Cardinality 0 is the exact uninitialized sentinel; Oracle.initialize returns 1 and callbacks validate the immutable manager and pool.
assumptions: The compared value remains an initialization sentinel, a block identity, or an unsigned zero-amount rejection rather than an exact target balance.

description:

	- latestLocator.blockNumber == currentBlock (contracts/MintingGateway.sol#1238)
reason: Equality intentionally extends an existing same-block locator; a later block starts a new locator.
assumptions: The compared value remains an initialization sentinel, a block identity, or an unsigned zero-amount rejection rather than an exact target balance.

reason: Every consumed field is assigned before use. The gateway assigns timestamp. Solidity initializes declared variables to type defaults.
assumptions: Every consumed purchase field remains assigned before use, including timestamp assignment by burnFromSwap.

reason: Only tick and separately fetched liquidity are inputs to the cumulative history; price and fees are unnecessary.
assumptions: Omitted tuple fields remain unnecessary to the operation. Quote execution still returns through a validated revert payload and rejects normal unlock success.
